title: Convert a validated niche into an AI app and paid offer
purpose: Verify that solution blueprinting turns research evidence into a concrete MVP, pricing, delivery, and go-to-market test.
prompt: Turn a validated niche, 'AI system for Polish creators to repurpose YouTube into Skool, newsletter, and social posts', into an MVP blueprint, paid offer, lead magnet, demo, delivery workflow, and validation plan.
expected_behaviors: Defines buyer, job-to-be-done, must-have workflow, MVP scope, inputs, outputs, and success metrics.
Connects features to evidence from paid intent, keywords, community pain, competitors, and Poland adaptation.
Proposes pricing, setup/retainer or subscription model, demo path, lead magnet, and YouTube content angle.
States what not to build in v1.
Defines a validation plan before full build.
failure_patterns: Creates an overbroad product spec without a buyer or validation step.
Adds features unrelated to the paid pain.
Omits pricing, offer, delivery, or acquisition.
judge_notes: Passing output must include a constrained MVP and a paid validation path.
